about_offline_first: RebornTask uses an offline-first approach. Your data is stored locally on your device first and then synchronized to the server in the background.
about_e2e: All your data is end-to-end encrypted, meaning that only your device can read the actual content of your tasks, lists, and subtasks. The server only stores encrypted data.
about_resolution: If conflicts occur between devices, the system automatically resolves them using the 'last update wins' strategy, but preserves all your data whenever possible.
connect_to_sync: Connect to the internet to synchronize
automatic_info: Synchronization works automatically in the background. Manual actions are optional and intended for advanced troubleshooting or to force sync in rare cases.
partial_failure: Sync completed, but {count} operations failed. Tap again to clear.

indicator.conflict_message: Newer data was detected on the server. Updated data has been downloaded.
